review: Oh my word, three children under six means this house is never quiet and never the right kind of quiet, and this album runs from breakfast to bath and I know every word. "Woof Woof, Thank You, God." My middle one sang it during the offering at St. Paul's and the whole pew heard it. I have told nine mothers in my playgroup which is nine more than any advertisement has managed. I had a career I was good at and I have never once said out loud that I miss it, and I am not sure why I am typing that here. Five stars.
